title: Cinnamon Apples
description: Sliced apples tossed with brown sugar, cinnamon and nutmeg and simmered in butter until tender.

steps.heading: Toss
steps.text: Toss the apples, brown sugar, cinnamon and nutmeg together in a large zip-top bag until the apples are coated.

steps.heading: Cook
steps.text: Cook the apple mixture with 2 tbsp water and the butter in a medium saucepan over medium heat, stirring occasionally, for 8 to 10 minutes, until the apples are tender.
